propositions: A function whose os.environ key expression references its own parameters is an env-read helper that must be registered in KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS or the scan fails closed with UnregisteredEnvReadHelper

Missing KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS rows for parameterized shims cause environment variables to be silently dropped from the registry, as demonstrated by _gate_str_pref leaving REBAR_GATE_REF and REBAR_GATE_SOURCE undocumented
The generator must fail closed symmetrically for both os.environ attribute accesses and unregistered env-read helpers to meet the seam contract documented at _config_resolvers.py:288-289

Detecting parameterized-shim helpers by dataflow (parameter reference in key expression) is enumerable across the codebase and fires on exactly 9 of 557 files, avoiding false positives from overgeneralized body-scanning heuristics
